options.name: label
options.description: Visible label of the control; names the group.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text, referenced by the group.

options.name: items
options.description: All items { value, label, description?, disabled? }; values are unique.

options.name: value
options.description: Selected values in Selected-list order; unknown values are dropped.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name: one hidden input per selected value.

options.name: required
options.description: At least one item must be selected.

options.name: minSelected
options.description: At least this many items when any are selected (or when required).

options.name: maxSelected
options.description: Hard limit; moves beyond it are refused and announced.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Lists can be browsed and searched, but nothing moves.

options.name: searchable
options.description: Show a search box above each list.

options.name: draggable
options.description: Drag items between the lists with a pointer.

options.name: visibleRows
options.description: Rows visible in each list before it scrolls (3 to 50).

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of counts, messages, and search matching.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Selected values in Selected-list order (a copy).

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: The value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control once.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear searches, checks, and messages.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; an invalid update leaves the previous state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, and the form registration.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: Items moved: { value, validity, moved, to }.

cssClasses.name: aui-transfer-list__body
cssClasses.description: The group holding the lists and buttons.

cssClasses.name: aui-transfer-list__panel | __panel--available | __panel--selected | __panel--drop
cssClasses.description: A list panel and the drop-target state.

cssClasses.name: aui-transfer-list__option | __option--active | __option--draggable
cssClasses.description: An option, the active option, and a draggable option.

cssClasses.name: aui-transfer-list__check | __label | __desc
cssClasses.description: Check box indicator, label, and description.
